payment.title: Payment Terms
payment.content: The core features are free forever and require no credit card; you pay only for the annual licence, modules, integrations and capacity items you buy, plus any one-time credits and services. Annual items are billed in advance and prorated to the days remaining until your account's anniversary, so everything lands on one invoice that renews on a single date. Renewal is manual: we do not store cards or charge them automatically. If an item goes unpaid, access to those paid features stops after a 7-day grace period, while your data is retained. Payments are collected through PayTR in Turkish Lira only. All fees are non-refundable except as expressly set forth in these terms. We reserve the right to change our prices with 30 days notice.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions about QR menus

items.a: A QR menu is a digital menu that opens when guests scan a code on the table with their phone camera, replacing the printed menu. Guests see your menu in the browser without installing an app, and you update prices and items instantly.

items.q: Is the QR menu really free?
items.a: Yes. The QR menu is part of HummyTummy's free core: there are no item, category, table or view limits. Only optional modules (such as delivery integrations) are paid.

items.q: How do I create a QR code menu?
items.a: Sign up for free, add your menu in the panel or upload a photo of your printed menu for AI import, then download and print your table QR codes as a PDF. Most businesses finish in 5–10 minutes.

items.q: Do guests have to install an app?
items.a: No. The code is scanned with the phone camera and the menu opens in the browser; no extra app is needed on iOS or Android.

items.q: Can guests order through the QR menu?
items.a: Yes. You can keep the menu view-only or enable ordering from the table; orders land on the kitchen display and the register automatically.
Open the item in the admin panel and type the new price; the change is live on every table within seconds. No reprinting, no new QR code.

items.q: Can the menu be shown in more than one language?
items.a: The menu interface opens in five languages: Turkish, English, Russian, Arabic and Uzbek. The guest switches language with one tap and category headings and button text follow. Item names and descriptions appear in whatever language you entered them — per-item translation does not exist yet.

items.q: Can I add photos to items?
items.a: Yes. Drag and drop a photo onto the item in the panel and it appears next to the item on the menu. The number of photos does not change the price.

items.q: Which countries and cities can I use it in?
items.a: HummyTummy is currently active in Türkiye and Uzbekistan. In Türkiye you can start the same day in all 81 provinces. In Uzbekistan your account opens in so‘m with QQS tax rates and an Uzbek interface, and receipts print in Cyrillic. The system is cloud-based and works in any business with an internet connection.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions about cloud kitchens

items.a: A cloud kitchen (ghost kitchen) is a kitchen that produces only for delivery, with no dining room. One kitchen can run several virtual brands; orders arrive from platforms like Yemeksepeti and Getir.
Yemeksepeti, Getir Yemek, Trendyol Yemek and Migros Yemek. Orders are received automatically and merged into one screen.

items.q: How do orders reach the kitchen?
items.a: A platform order lands on the kitchen display (KDS) within seconds, tagged with its platform; nobody needs to sit next to a tablet.

items.q: Can I manage several brands from one kitchen?
items.a: Yes. You define a separate menu and categories for each virtual brand; there is no limit on menus. If you want to run brands as separate branches, the first branch is free and each additional branch is added with an annual licence.

The core system (POS, kitchen display, menu, QR menu) is free and unlimited. Platform integrations are purchased as modules with an annual licence; current prices are in the pricing section on the homepage.

items.q: My restaurant has a dining room and also delivers — is this for me?
items.a: Yes. The integrations aren't only for cloud kitchens; any restaurant running dine-in plus delivery manages both channels from the same screen.
